newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metalcorp buys Wanless after Simsmet block.
newsitem.headline: Metalcorp buys Wanless after Simsmet block.

text.p: Metal recycler Metalcorp Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to buy Queensland-based Wanless Metal Industries Pty Ltd after rival Simsmetal Ltd was blocked from making a bid by the anti-monopolies regulator.
Metalcorp did not reveal the purchase price but said the acquisition would include a share issue and would be earnings per share positive.
It said the agreement was subject to the completion of satisfactory contracts and the completion of an agreed stocktake at the end of June.

Simsmetal had first rights of refusal to bid for Wanless, which has eight sites in Queensland, but the international metals recycler was told by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission that the bid would reduce competition in Queensland.
